claims.text: A data augmentation approach is proposed to improve coreference resolution in machine translation, specifically tailored to pronoun translation.
The augmentation involves creating new training examples by modifying the gender of pronouns in sentences where the antecedent is not present.
The goal of the augmentation is to reduce bias towards neuter pronouns and improve performance on gender-specific translations.
